summary: All prompt requirements verified. Sun rendered at the center of the three concentric dotted orbit rings (~640,400) with a 'Sun' label below it, no overlap. Exactly 3 planets (Mercuria, Aquara, Terraxa) are present and in all three frames each planet's center lies on its own orbit path (measured radii: 120/119.6/119.4 px inner, 189/190/190 px middle, 259/261/260 px outer against ring radii 120/187/261). Positions are distinct in every frame and angular rates are distinct and radius-ordered (~97 deg/s, ~55 deg/s, ~35 deg/s), matching the 4s/7s/11s SMIL durations. Motion is still mid-cycle at t=5s, so no frozen end state; all six orbit animations use repeatCount="indefinite" with default linear interpolation. Labels ride with their planets in every frame, remain upright and horizontal, are high-contrast white text on dark badges, and do not overlap the sun, the planets, each other, or the title/subtitle. No console errors, no overflow (scrollW/H 1280x720).
